title: 24 · blind_son · The Blind Son
lines: Parvati once covered Shiva's eyes. Just for a moment. As a game.
And the darkness had a child.
He was born blind, crying, from the heat of that one moment.
A childless demon king was praying for a son.
Shiva gave the boy to him.
He grew up strong, and angry, and unloved.
And he never knew whose son he was.
He won a boon. He won the worlds.
And one day he heard of a woman on a mountain, more beautiful than anything alive.
He did not know she was his mother.
Shiva lifted him on the trident.
And held him there. Above the world. For a thousand years.
Up there, in the heat of Shiva's gaze, everything in him burned away.
When there was nothing left but a thin, laughing devotee,
Shiva set him down, and called him his own.
No one is too far gone to be brought home. That is sadhana.
